name: Self storage
title: Best Self Storage in Leeds
intro: Moving house, renovating, clearing a spare room or storing stock for a small business. Below are 3 self storage facilities in Leeds with strong Google reviews, what each one offers and what to check before you sign up.
seo_title: Self Storage Leeds: 3 Local Storage Units Compared (2026)
seo_desc: Self storage in Leeds from 3 local facilities with strong Google reviews. Unit sizes, access hours, security, deals and what to check before you store.
h1: Best self storage in Leeds: 3 local storage facilities
checks: Ask for the full weekly or monthly price after any half price offer ends, and how much notice you must give to leave.
Ask what insurance or contents cover you need, what it costs and what it covers.
Ask about access hours, parking and loading, and whether the unit is alarmed or padlocked by you.

guide.h2: How much self storage do I need?
ul: 25 to 35 sq ft: a few boxes, a bike, or the contents of a student room
50 sq ft: about half a single garage, enough for a one bedroom flat
100 sq ft: about a single garage, enough for a two or three bedroom house
150 to 200 sq ft: about a double garage, for a larger family home

guide.h2: What does self storage cost in Leeds?
p: Most Leeds stores give prices by quote, and when we checked in November 2026 several were advertising half price for the first 8 to 12 weeks, so always ask for the full price after the offer ends. Checkatrade's 2026 guide gives UK averages of about £95 a month for 50 sq ft and £190 a month for 100 sq ft. See our self storage cost guide for Leeds for the full breakdown.

guide.h2: Storage while moving house in Leeds
p: Storage often fills the gap when a sale completes before the new home is ready. Many removal companies in Leeds offer their own container storage, and a man and van can move smaller loads into a unit for you. If you are clearing things out for good rather than storing them, house clearance may cost less than months of rent.

Small businesses use self storage for stock, tools and archive boxes, and some Leeds stores will take deliveries for you. Students at the universities in Leeds often store a room's worth of belongings over the summer, and several stores offer student deals and smaller units for this.

guide.h2: What to check before you sign up
ul: The full price after any introductory offer, and the notice period to leave
Insurance: whether you must buy the store's cover or can use your own
Access hours, parking and how close you can get a van to the unit
Who holds the key or code, and whether the unit is individually alarmed
Any deposit, admin or padlock charge, and what is refunded when you leave

faqs.q: How much does a storage unit cost in Leeds?
faqs.a: Most Leeds stores quote prices individually. Checkatrade's 2026 guide gives UK averages of about £95 a month for a 50 sq ft unit and £190 a month for 100 sq ft. Smaller items can cost less: The Store Room in Leeds lists single item storage from £1.25 a week.

faqs.q: What size storage unit do I need for a three bedroom house?
faqs.a: Usually around 100 to 150 sq ft, about the size of a single garage or a little more. Store staff can suggest a size if you list your larger furniture.

faqs.q: Do I need insurance for self storage?
faqs.a: Most stores require your goods to be covered, either through their own protection scheme or your home insurance. Ask what the store's cover costs and what value it covers.

faqs.q: Can I get into my storage unit at any time?
faqs.a: It depends on the store. Some Leeds stores give access seven days a week during set hours, and some offer longer or 24 hour access on request. Check the access hours before you choose.

faqs.q: Is there a minimum term for self storage?
faqs.a: Many stores have no long minimum term and simply ask for notice before you leave. Big Yellow, for example, asks for 14 days on most rooms and refunds unused days. Check the notice period before you sign.
